summary: Mirrors part of an image over itself, using pivot, rotation, extend mode, and X/Y flips to build mirrored image effects.

key_params.name: pivot
key_params.note: Pivot point components pivotx and pivoty

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: hold, zero, repeat, or mirror outside-source behavior

common_gotchas: Pivot units change results across resolutions and aspect ratios.
An off-center pivot can move samples outside the source image, making Extend visible.
Flip X/Y are not the same as the rotated mirror-copy behavior.
The official unit token for Fraction Aspect is fractionaspect.
key_concepts: Mirrors part of an image over itself.
Pivot and Pivot Unit define the point around which the copied image rotates.
Rotate turns the copied/mirrored image around the pivot before compositing back over itself.
Extend controls how out-of-bounds samples are held, zeroed, repeated, or mirrored.
Flip X and Flip Y are independent axis flips distinct from rotation around the pivot.
The operator supports 3D Textures and 2D Texture Arrays.
